results.reasoning: Judged by building fixtures under a private scratch directory with a fresh WALKDOWN_HOME and WALKDOWN_SKILLS_DIR per probe and driving the real CLI and a server on ports of my own, never the suite. Every door n-0170 named is closed when re-driven: a plain init in mono/app/packs/app is its own project and a thread filed at the root lands at the root; an abandoned home is never re-minted (the next same-named checkout gets 0002-app and app-2, the abandoned one answers with its own gone home); project add from outside a self-declaring checkout refuses and mints nothing; move writes into a pure-override row; relocating the middle of three same-named checkouts in and out coincides with nothing; fifteen asking commands from three directories and six server GETs left every tree byte-identical by sha256. It fails at the next doors, in the one arrangement that fix made correct: the root and the pack are now two projects, but three selectors still pick between them by the id they share. From inside the pack, --project app answers the root - thread new --project app filed n-0003 into the root ledger from the directory where the bare command files into the pack, and projects there calls the answering entry shadowed. A server started in the pack lists two rows named app the chooser cannot tell apart, and ?bp=app selects the root: POST /api/threads?bp=app on the pack server wrote n-0004 into the root ledger. move evidence at the root moved the root screenshots and recorded the destination on the pack personal row, so the root answers a directory that no longer exists and the pack answers the root evidence - rememberLocation still matches by id plus containment in either direction, the test the merge dropped. And relocation ignores a personal row already about the checkout: after move evidence in a committed project, init --commit none appended repo-2 beside the move row, the specless row won the tie, the command printed the spec did not land at null and scaffolded a new blueprint into the tree under the sentence that nothing was added, and the checkout then denies being a project while n-0001 sits in a home reachable only by --project repo-2; the same relocation the other way drops a moved evidence key so the moved screenshots are named by nothing. One blueprint given a second home with its records stranded, and paths still resolving through a shared name, at the --project flag, the server list and the move - the three places the steps name. Details, transcripts and one observation about the --fix report in n-0173. Claiming, not accepting.
